scope: posthoc diagnostics only for original 502 modified grid positions (scan1 174, scan6 328); six zero-anchor cases remain out-of-support failures
primary_reference: same published raw-camera-to-GT Sim3 and 200000 evenly spaced STL vertices; all affected points, no ROI; no point-to-point identity truth
sensitivity_reference: all existing STL vertices with same alignment; this is a new diagnostic resource profile, not replacement of published metric or official DTU evaluation
ROI_sensitivity: fixed raw ObsMask only, report denominator separately
oracle_extra_action: actual frozen weighted fraction per point
oracle_scope: pointwise min distance among finite fixed actions, ties choose raw/earlier action; not global F1 upper bound, never deployment
counterfactuals: GT-camera-assisted colmap-to-GT similarity using orientations/centers, fixed original correspondences and beta; GT-only diagnostic, not error-free true alignment
bilinear raw XYZ at original continuous observation, fixed anchor and beta; interpolation sensitivity, not proof of true correspondence or a deployable correction
factorial combination of above two; report interactions without causal percentage attribution
identifiability: all predeclared scalar ranks; higher score predicts frozen fusion benefit; AUROC, Spearman, unique-landmark means, source-view strata; no training, sign fitting, threshold optimization or new fusion policy
ties: include entire score tie group, show actual coverage
grouping: same classical point ID is a dependent group; source-view and object-level limitations explicit

continue_criteria_exploratory_not_statis.complementarity: oracle mean distance gain >=10% and full endpoint better on >=20% of points in BOTH scenes under primary reference, confirm gain direction with full reference
continue_criteria_exploratory_not_statis.identifiability: at least one prespecified same-direction signal AUROC>=0.65 and unique-landmark mean AUROC>=0.60 in BOTH scenes, top25% positive mean gain above matched random expectation; report all signals, not a significance test
continue_criteria_exploratory_not_statis.interpretation: only conditional small follow-up if both pass; if complementarity alone passes, do not expand existing weighting or claim stable benefit

splits: scan1 and scan6 both previously inspected; exploratory retrospective diagnostics, no fresh blind test
